pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Build-time helper module used by the setup.py of the various dev-util/buildbot-* www plugin packages (buildbot-www, buildbot-console-view, buildbot-grid-view, buildbot-waterfall-view, buildbot-wsgi-dashboards, buildbot-badges). It is not imported by any of their installed runtime code, only by their setup.py at build time.
Re-added to this overlay after ::gentoo removed it (bug #952430, 2026-08-21) for lack of a maintainer and Python 3.13 support.
